# Shreyas Salian — Academic and Research Portfolio
# https://shreyassalian.netlify.app/
# Last updated: 2026-11-16

## Identity

Shreyas Salian is an Electronics and Communication Engineering (ECE) undergraduate
at M S Ramaiah University of Applied Sciences, Bangalore (expected graduation: 2027).
He completed a Major in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning at IIT Ropar
(August 2024 – February 2026). He conducted a research internship at IIT (BHU),
Varanasi (March 2026 – November 2026). His research interests span federated
learning, machine unlearning, statistical modelling, wireless communication systems,
and biomedical AI.

## Research Manuscripts (all statuses current as of November 2026)

1. AdaptFlux: A Server-Side Aggregation Method for Heterogeneous Federated Learning —
   Formulation, Corrections, and Controlled Evaluation
   First Author. Under Review.
   Analyses representation-aware weighting and gradient-divergence correction for
   federated learning under non-IID data distributions. Identifies limitations and
   proposes corrected aggregation components.

2. A Workload-Aware Constraint-Based Framework for Automated Academic Timetable
   Generation
   First Author. Under Review.
   Constraint-based scheduling framework enforcing institutional hard constraints and
   workload-aware faculty assignment.

3. Sampling Noise and the Consistency of Online Sentiment: An Analysis of the Sentiment
   Consistency Index, a Sample-Size-Aware Correction, and Evidence from Real Text
   First Author. Under Review.
   Analyses statistical limitations of the Sentiment Consistency Index; proposes
   sample-size-aware corrections evaluated on movie-review and tweet datasets.

4. Explainable Deep Learning for Physical-Layer Classification of Wi-Fi, LTE and 5G-NR
   Signals Using SHAP (SHapley Additive exPlanations)
   Second Author. In Preparation.
   Investigates a deep neural network with SHAP feature-importance analysis for
   physical-layer wireless signal classification.

5. Federated Unlearning for Neural Equalizers in 6G Wireless Communication Systems
   Conference Submission. Under Review.
   Client-level federated unlearning evaluation for neural equalizers using canary-based
   forgetting assessment and Gold-relative equivalence testing.

6. Patient-Specific Predictive Cardiac Digital Twin for Early Ventricular Arrhythmia
   Forecasting
   Conference Submission. Under Review.
   Patient-specific ECG (Electrocardiogram) beat classification and retrospective
   ventricular-fibrillation forecasting using XGBoost and Transformer architectures
   with PYNQ-Z2 ARM inference.

None of these manuscripts have been accepted or published as of this date.
